appTagline: Urban Air Quality & Smog Day Assistant
appDescription: Turns the live air quality forecast into a safer daily plan. Exposure and emissions are worked out by calculation, not guesswork.

hero.title: Plan a safer day when the air is bad
hero.body: Tell us who lives in your home and how each person travels. We fetch the air quality forecast for your city, work out when each person breathes the most smoke, and suggest changes you can actually make.
hero.step2: We check the air hour by hour
hero.step3: Get a plan with numbers you can check

form.title: Household profile
form.cityPlaceholder: e.g. New Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai, Patna
form.cityHint: We fetch PM2.5, PM10 and the hourly forecast from Open-Meteo.
form.cookingHint: Burning wood or dung adds a lot of smoke indoors.
form.incenseCoil: We burn incense or mosquito coils indoors
form.incenseHint: The smoke adds fine particles to indoor air.
form.purifier: We have an air purifier at home
form.purifierHint: A running purifier removes most fine particles from the room.
form.membersHint: Children, older people and people with lung or heart conditions are affected most.
form.maxMembers: You can add up to 10 members.
form.outdoorHint: Walks, play, exercise or work outside.
form.demoHint: Pick a sample to fill the form, then create the plan.
form.demoPatna: Patna: wood fuel and outdoor work
form.generating: Checking the air and building your plan...

modes.work_from_home: Stays home or works from home

metrics.highestRisk: Most exposed on a normal day

sections.timeline: Normal day and optimized day, side by side

results.heading: Your day plan for {city}
results.dataUpdated: Air quality data from {time} local time
results.exposureHint: Fall in the PM2.5 the household breathes in over the day, if the plan is followed.
results.emissionsHint: {kg} kg CO₂e a day, about {pct}% of the household's travel emissions.
results.hourlyTitle: Air quality over the next 24 hours
results.hourlyDescription: Each bar is one hour. The AQI number is printed on every bar, and the table lists the same values with their category.
results.showTable: Show these numbers as a table
results.safeWindowsNote: The cleanest stretch of the next 24 hours for each kind of outing. Choose these when you can.
results.noSafeWindows: There is not enough hourly data to pick cleaner time windows.
results.timelineIntro: What changes between a normal day and the optimized day, hour by hour.
results.noModeSwaps: No change of transport is suggested. Everyone already travels in a low-emission way, or stays home.
results.methodNote: The percentages and kilograms on this page are calculated by the app from the air quality data. The AI only writes the explanations.

banners.modelled: Live air quality data could not be reached, so these numbers use a typical winter pattern for the region. Use them as a rough guide only.
banners.fallbackPlan: The AI service was not available, so this plan was built by the app's built-in rules. The numbers are calculated the same way.
banners.englishOnly: Some explanations in this plan are in English because the built-in rules write them.
banners.updatingLanguage: Updating the plan in your chosen language...

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.invalid_request: Some details are not valid. Please check the form and try again.
errors.city_not_found: We could not find that city. Check the spelling or try a larger city nearby.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

whatIf.intro: Ask how one change would affect emissions and exposure. The app recalculates first, then the AI explains the new numbers.
whatIf.question: Your question
whatIf.placeholder: e.g. What if I cycle to work instead?
whatIf.example1: What if I take the metro instead?
whatIf.example3: What if I work from home?
whatIf.emissionsLine: Household travel emissions: {before} kg to {after} kg CO₂e a day.
whatIf.exposureSame: Exposure to PM2.5 stays about the same.

unmatched.no_mode: Name a way of travelling, for example metro, bus, cycling or walking.
unmatched.same_mode: {name} already travels this way. Try a different mode.
unmatched.no_commute: {name} does not travel for work, so there is nothing to change.

whatIf.numbersNote: The numbers above come from the app's own calculation.

advisory.intro: Write a short notice you can post in a residents' group or send to a school.
advisory.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

footer.disclaimer: AuraGuide AI gives general guidance and is not medical advice. If you have a heart or lung condition, follow your doctor's advice.
footer.dataCredit: Air quality data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0). AQI follows the CPCB National AQI bands used in India.
footer.method: How the numbers work: each person's exposure adds up the PM2.5 they breathe hour by hour, weighted for age and health. Emissions use a fixed factor per kilometre for each kind of transport.
